name: Raleigh
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Raleigh for 2026, and here is what he found: 23 family events, 12 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Fieldstream Farm Christmas Light Show) through December 31 (Fieldstream Farm Christmas Light Show), with the State Capitol State Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 1), the St Nicholas European Christmas Market (December 4) and the Carolina Ballet Nutcracker (December 10 to 24) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Raleigh

  • 23 Christmas events for kids in Raleigh
  • 12 free events, including the State Capitol Holiday Open House and the Moore Square Winterfaire
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Surprise Shop at Roberts Park, Santa's Trolley at Mordecai Historic Park and Pancakes and Pics with Santa at The Wright Village
  • Trains and lights: Holiday Express at Pullen Park and the Fieldstream Farm Christmas Light Show
  • Stage and music: the Carolina Ballet Nutcracker and Holiday Pops with the North Carolina Symphony
  • Season: November 27, 2026 to December 31, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Raleigh families also use our guides to Christmas activities for kids in Cary and Durham, which cover the NC Chinese Lantern Festival at Koka Booth Amphitheatre and the Durham library cookie crafts.
